Feeder is an infrastructure identifier (numeric ID) for an electrical distribution feeder. It is not personal data under DPV/GDPR as it does not directly or indirectly identify a natural person. It identifies a physical grid asset. While it narrows geographic scope, combined with 70+ housing units it does not enable re-identification of individuals. It is a DCAT resource identifier for the dataset's spatial granularity.

Substation is an infrastructure identifier for a power substation. Similar to feeder, it is a physical asset identifier, not personal data. It does not relate to an identified or identifiable natural person per DPV. The combination with feeder defines a grid segment but at the aggregate level of 70+ units, individual re-identification is not feasible.

Date is a temporal attribute indicating when the measurement was taken. It is not personal data and does not identify any individual. In the context of aggregate grid data, the date provides temporal context for consumption patterns. No DPV-sensitive category applies.

This is an aggregate count of housing units (70-72) within the feeder area. It is statistical/aggregate data, not personal data. It does not identify any specific individual or household. Under DPV, aggregate statistics that do not allow re-identification of individuals are not considered personal data. The count is sufficiently large to prevent inference about specific persons.

This is an aggregate count of industrial and commercial entities (11) in the feeder area. It is statistical data about the number of businesses, not identifying any specific business or individual. Under DPV, this does not constitute personal data as it is a non-identifiable aggregate metric.

This is the aggregate total installed capacity (kW) of storage heaters across all consumers in the feeder. It is a technical/infrastructure metric at the grid segment level. No individual consumer can be identified from this aggregate value. Not personal data under DPV.

Aggregate installed capacity of heat pumps in the feeder area. This is a technical infrastructure metric, not personal data. The value (2.1 kW) represents a total across all consumers and cannot be attributed to any specific individual or household.

Aggregate installed capacity of electric heaters in the feeder. Technical infrastructure data at the grid segment level. Does not identify any natural person. Not subject to DPV anonymization requirements.
Aggregate installed capacity of hot water tanks in the feeder area. This is a technical load characteristic of the grid segment, not personal data. Cannot be used to identify any individual consumer.

Aggregate installed capacity of flow-type heaters in the feeder. Technical infrastructure metric at the grid level. No personal data implications under DPV. The value represents a total across all consumers in the area.

Aggregate installed capacity of EV chargers in the feeder area. Technical infrastructure data. The value (0.0 kW) indicates no EV chargers are present. This is a grid-level metric, not personal data, and does not identify any individual.

Aggregate installed capacity of public lighting in the feeder area. This is municipal/infrastructure data, not personal data. Public lighting is a shared utility and the kW value is a technical specification of the grid segment.

Aggregate installed capacity of other/unclassified consumers in the feeder. Technical infrastructure metric at the grid segment level. Does not identify any specific individual or business. Not personal data under DPV.

Aggregate installed capacity of battery storage systems in the feeder area. Technical infrastructure data at the grid level. The value (0.0 kW) indicates no batteries present. Not personal data and cannot identify any individual.

Aggregate installed capacity of photovoltaic systems in the feeder area. Technical infrastructure metric. The value (0.0 kW) indicates no PV systems. This is grid-level data, not personal data, and does not enable identification of any individual.

Aggregate installed capacity of combined heat and power (CHP) systems in the feeder. Technical infrastructure data at the grid segment level. Does not identify any specific individual or business. Not personal data under DPV.

Aggregate general electricity consumption (kWh) for the feeder area. This is a grid-level consumption metric representing total energy used by all consumers. With 70+ housing units, individual consumption cannot be isolated. Not personal data under DPV.

Aggregate workday electricity consumption (kWh) for the feeder area. Grid-level consumption pattern data. Represents total energy used on workdays across all consumers. Cannot be attributed to any specific individual. Not personal data.

Aggregate evening electricity consumption (kWh) for the feeder area. Grid-level consumption pattern data. Represents total evening energy usage across all consumers in the segment. Not identifiable to any individual. Not personal data under DPV.

Aggregate continuous electricity consumption (kWh) for the feeder area. Grid-level consumption metric representing baseline/continuous load. The value (0.0) indicates no continuous load. Not personal data and cannot identify any individual.

Aggregate electricity consumption of shops and hairdressers in the feeder area. While it references specific business types, it is an aggregate value across all such businesses in the area (11 industrial/commercial entities total). It does not identify a specific business or individual. Under DPV, aggregate business consumption at this granularity does not constitute personal data.

Aggregate electricity consumption of bakeries in the feeder area. Similar to g4, this is an aggregate value for a business category within the feeder. The value (0.0) indicates no bakery consumption. It does not identify a specific business or natural person. Not personal data under DPV.

Aggregate weekend electricity consumption (kWh) for the feeder area. Grid-level consumption pattern data representing total weekend energy usage. Cannot be attributed to any specific individual or household. Not personal data under DPV.
